pkgmetadata.longdescription: Sumy is a Python library for automatic summarization of text documents and HTML pages. It implements several summarization algorithms including Luhn, LSA (Latent Semantic Analysis), TextRank, LexRank, SumBasic, and others. It supports many human languages.

use.flag: Enable Chinese language support via jieba segmenter
Enable LSA and LexRank summarizers that require numpy
